from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissionData(BaseModel):
    """Admission statistics for one university from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Total first-time, first-year degree-seeking applicants")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Total first-time, first-year degree-seeking admitted students")
    admission_cycle: str | None = Field(description="The admission cycle/academic year, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_admission_data: list[UniversityAdmissionData]
